guides.title: Heroic Hellfire Citadel: the Flamewrought Key
guides.summary: Heroic Hellfire Ramparts, The Blood Furnace and The Shattered Halls open with the Flamewrought Key, sold by the Honor Hold or Thrallmar quartermaster once your standing is high enough. Reputation comes from the Hellfire Peninsula quest lines, the Hellfire Citadel dungeons themselves and the daily Hellfire Fortifications PvP quest. On Anniversary realms a main who has reached Revered can also buy a Communal pouch whose account bound key gives alts heroic access at Friendly.
guides.unlocks: Heroic difficulty for Hellfire Ramparts, The Blood Furnace and The Shattered Halls, plus the heroic daily quests that send you there.

phase.notes: The key is required for the whole of TBC (keys were only removed in Cataclysm 4.2). The standing needed to buy it was Revered from launch and dropped to Honored with the Zul'Aman update: original patch 2.3, TBC Classic Phase 4 (patch 2.5.4, 22 March 2022) and Anniversary realms on 22 October 2026 (Blizzard calls it the next content phase, press calls it phase 3.5; it is phase 4 in this guide's numbering). The Anniversary key sold in phases 1 to 3 was Revered; the Wowhead Anniversary tooltip still shows Revered two days after the change, so the endpoint lags live data.

steps.title: Reach level 70
steps.detail: Heroic dungeons admit level 70 characters only, and the Hellfire Peninsula quest lines that pay the bulk of early Honor Hold or Thrallmar reputation run from 58 to 63. Finish the zone's hubs (Honor Hold or Thrallmar, then Expedition Point or Falcon Watch) as you level; the reputation they pay is banked towards the key. Everything else in this guide can be done in any order once you are 70.

steps.title: Run the Hellfire Fortifications daily when you pass by
steps.detail: Capture the Overlook, the Stadium and Broken Hill (the three PvP towers in central Hellfire Peninsula) while your faction holds them and hand in to the warrant officer in your town. It pays 150 reputation, 70 silver and three Marks of Honor Hold (item 24579) or Marks of Thrallmar (item 24581). The marks are PvP currency spent at the same quartermasters on gear and consumables; there is no mark hand in for reputation in TBC. It is a daily, so it is a steady top up rather than a route on its own.
steps.detectedBy: IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(10106) for Alliance or IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(10110) for Horde is true only until the next daily reset; show it as a repeatable tip, never as a gate.

steps.title: Reach Revered with Honor Hold or Thrallmar
steps.detail: Before the Zul'Aman phase the key needs Revered, 21000 points past Neutral. The Hellfire Peninsula quest hubs carry most characters to Friendly or early Honored; Hellfire Ramparts (map 543) and The Blood Furnace (542) pay on normal only until Honored and then stop. From Honored the grind is The Shattered Halls (540, level 70, its door needs the Shattered Halls Key or a rogue with 350 lockpicking), which keeps paying on normal to Exalted, and Nether-Stalker Mah'duun's normal daily Wanted: Shattered Hand Centurions (250 reputation). Every Hellfire heroic also pays to Exalted, but each member needs the key to zone in, so heroics only help once you hold one. The Hellfire Fortifications daily adds 150 a day.
steps.detectedBy: select(3, GetFactionInfoByID(946)) >= 7 for Alliance, or GetFactionInfoByID(947) for Horde (standingID 7 = Revered). Pick the faction by UnitFactionGroup("player").

steps.title: Reach Honored with Honor Hold or Thrallmar
steps.detail: From the Zul'Aman phase the quartermaster sells the Flamewrought Key at Honored, 9000 points past Neutral. The Hellfire Peninsula quest lines plus a handful of Hellfire Ramparts (map 543) and Blood Furnace (542) runs reach it; those two dungeons stop paying at Honored, which is now exactly the standing you need. If you are short, The Shattered Halls (540) on normal, the Hellfire Fortifications daily (150) and Mah'duun's Wanted: Shattered Hand Centurions daily (250) all count. Anniversary realms switched on 22 October 2026; TBC Classic 2021 switched on 22 March 2022.
steps.detectedBy: select(3, GetFactionInfoByID(946)) >= 6 for Alliance, or GetFactionInfoByID(947) for Horde (standingID 6 = Honored).

steps.title: Buy the Flamewrought Key
steps.detail: Visit Logistics Officer Ulrike in Honor Hold (Alliance) or Quartermaster Urgronn outside the Thrallmar stronghold (Horde) and buy the Flamewrought Key for 10 gold. It binds when picked up, is unique and goes straight to your keyring; you never use it, holding it is the attunement. One key covers all three Hellfire Citadel heroics. The vendor gates the sale on your standing, Revered before phase 4 and Honored from phase 4.
steps.detectedBy: GetItemCount(30622) > 0 for Alliance or GetItemCount(30637) > 0 for Horde (the keyring counts as a bag; confirm on the 2.5.6 client).

steps.title: Alts: hold a Communal Flamewrought Key at Friendly
steps.detail: Anniversary realms only. Once a character on your account is Revered the same quartermaster also sells the Communal Flamewrought Pouch for 80 gold (Alliance 265842, Horde 265829); opening it puts a Communal Flamewrought Key (265830 Alliance, 265826 Horde) in the keyring that binds to your Battle.net account and can be mailed between your characters. An alt needs only Friendly with Honor Hold or Thrallmar to hold it and enter heroics, and since the 12 February 2026 hotfix either faction's key works for a character that is Friendly with either faction. It is an item, not an account flag, so it must sit in the alt's keyring; pass it along as each alt earns its own key. Whether the pouch's own purchase requirement dropped to Honored on 22 October 2026 is not confirmed.
steps.detectedBy: (GetItemCount(265830) > 0 or GetItemCount(265826) > 0) and standingID >= 5 with faction 946 or 947.

steps.title: Set the dungeon difficulty to Heroic
steps.detail: Before anyone zones in, the party leader right clicks their own portrait, opens Dungeon Difficulty and chooses Heroic, or runs /run SetDungeonDifficultyID(2). The difficulty is taken from the leader, but every member who enters needs the key in their own keyring. Heroics require level 70, lock you to one run per dungeon per day and award a Badge of Justice from each boss. Since 22 October 2026 Anniversary heroics run at their final, reduced 2.4.3 difficulty.
steps.detectedBy: GetDungeonDifficultyID() == 2 at the moment of checking; it is a setting rather than a completion, so present it as a reminder rather than a tick.

guides.notes: Marks of Honor Hold and Marks of Thrallmar are PvP tokens from the Fortifications daily and kills near the towers; they are not a repeatable reputation hand in, so the route relies on dungeons and quests. The Shattered Halls Key (item 28395) belongs to the dungeon attunement researcher. Coordinates are map percentages computed from the world DB spawn through the client's UiMapAssignment boxes; they match the wiki where the wiki lists numbers.

guides.title: Heroic Coilfang Reservoir: the Reservoir Key
guides.summary: Heroic Slave Pens, Underbog and Steamvault open with the Reservoir Key, sold by Fedryen Swiftspear at Cenarion Refuge once your Cenarion Expedition standing is high enough. Zangarmarsh quests, the Coilfang dungeons and two repeatable hand ins (Unidentified Plant Parts and Coilfang Armaments) feed the faction. On Anniversary realms a Revered main can buy a Communal pouch whose account bound key covers alts at Friendly.
guides.unlocks: Heroic difficulty for The Slave Pens, The Underbog and The Steamvault, plus their heroic daily quests.

phase.notes: Key required throughout TBC. Revered from launch; Honored from the Zul'Aman update (original 2.3, TBC Classic Phase 4 on 22 March 2022, Anniversary on 22 October 2026, phase 4 in this numbering).

steps.title: Reach level 70
steps.detail: Heroics admit level 70 characters only. Quest through Zangarmarsh (Cenarion Refuge, Telredor or Zabra'jin, Orebor Harborage or Swamprat Post) at 60 to 64 and keep every Unidentified Plant Parts you loot from the zone's mobs; the Cenarion Expedition reputation and the plant parts both count towards the key later.

steps.title: Hand in your first ten Unidentified Plant Parts
steps.detail: Bring ten Unidentified Plant Parts (item 24401, dropped by most Zangarmarsh creatures and cheap on the auction house) to Lauranna Thar'well at Cenarion Refuge for 250 reputation and a Package of Identified Plants (item 24402). This unlocks the repeatable Identify Plant Parts (quest 9784), ten parts for 250 reputation each time, which the wiki records as available until Honored. Each package can contain an Uncatalogued Species (item 24407) that starts its own hand in (quest 9875, 500 reputation) and still works after Honored. A stack of 360 parts is roughly Neutral to Honored on its own.
steps.detectedBy: IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(9802). The repeatable 9784 and 9875 do not keep a completed flag.

steps.title: Deliver Orders from Lady Vashj

giver.name: Started by the item Orders from Lady Vashj (24367), dropped by naga in The Steamvault

steps.detail: The Orders from Lady Vashj (item 24367, level 67) drop from the naga in The Steamvault: Coilfang Myrmidons, Engineers, Sirens, Sorceresses, Warriors, Oracles and Slavemasters. Right click the orders and deliver them to Ysiel Windsinger on the back porch of the Cenarion Refuge inn for 500 reputation. Ysiel then offers Preparing for War (quest 9765, one Coilfang Armament for 250 reputation), which opens the repeatable Coilfang Armaments (quest 9766), 75 reputation per armament (item 24368) all the way to Exalted.

steps.title: Hand in your first Coilfang Armament
steps.detail: Coilfang Armaments (item 24368) drop from the naga throughout Coilfang Reservoir, mostly in The Steamvault, and trade freely so they can be bought. One armament completes Preparing for War for 250 reputation and unlocks the repeatable Coilfang Armaments (quest 9766) at 75 reputation each, which keeps paying through Exalted and is the usual filler between Steamvault runs. Keep every armament you loot from now on.

steps.title: Reach Revered with the Cenarion Expedition
steps.detail: Before the Zul'Aman phase the key needs Revered, 21000 points past Neutral. The Slave Pens (map 547) and The Underbog (546) pay reputation on normal only until Honored; The Steamvault (545, level 70) keeps paying on normal to Exalted at roughly 1100 to 1660 a full clear and is the main grind. Zangarmarsh quests give a few thousand, and Cenarion Expedition quests also appear at Cenarion Post in Hellfire, Cenarion Thicket in Terokkar and Evergrove in Blade's Edge. Repeatables: Identify Plant Parts (250 per ten parts, to Honored), Uncatalogued Species (500 each, any standing) and Coilfang Armaments (75 each, to Exalted). Nether-Stalker Mah'duun's normal Steamvault daily Wanted: Coilfang Myrmidons pays 250, and Wind Trader Zhareem's heroic dailies pay 350 once you hold the key.

steps.title: Reach Honored with the Cenarion Expedition
steps.detail: From the Zul'Aman phase the key is sold at Honored, 9000 points past Neutral. Zangarmarsh quests plus Slave Pens (map 547) and Underbog (546) runs reach it, and those two dungeons stop paying at exactly Honored. Identify Plant Parts (250 per ten Unidentified Plant Parts) is the quickest filler, since parts are cheap and the quest is available precisely until Honored. The Steamvault (545), Coilfang Armaments (75 each) and Mah'duun's Wanted: Coilfang Myrmidons daily (250) also count.

steps.title: Buy the Reservoir Key

It binds when picked up, is unique and sits in your keyring; holding it is the attunement for all three Coilfang heroics. The sale is gated on your standing, Revered before phase 4 and Honored from phase 4.

Once a character on the account is Revered, Fedryen also sells the Communal Reservoir Pouch (item 265844) for 80 gold; opening it yields a Communal Reservoir Key (item 265843) that binds to your Battle.net account and can be mailed between your characters. An alt needs only Friendly with the Cenarion Expedition to hold it and enter Coilfang heroics. It is an item, not an account flag, so it must sit in the alt's keyring. guides.title: Heroic Auchindoun: the Auchenai Key
guides.summary: Heroic Mana-Tombs, Auchenai Crypts, Sethekk Halls and Shadow Labyrinth open with the Auchenai Key, sold by Nakodu in Shattrath's Lower City once your Lower City standing is high enough. Terokkar Forest and Lower City quests, the Auchindoun dungeons and the repeatable Arakkoa Feather hand in feed the faction; Mana-Tombs pays the Consortium instead. On Anniversary realms a Revered main can buy a Communal pouch whose account bound key covers alts at Friendly.
guides.unlocks: Heroic difficulty for Mana-Tombs, Auchenai Crypts, Sethekk Halls and Shadow Labyrinth, plus their heroic daily quests.

steps.detail: Heroics admit level 70 characters only. Quest through Terokkar Forest and Shattrath's Lower City at 62 to 65 and keep every Arakkoa Feather you loot from the arakkoa camps; both the quest reputation and the feathers count towards the key.

steps.title: Hand in thirty Arakkoa Feathers to Vekax
steps.detail: Arakkoa Feathers (item 25719) drop from the arakkoa of Terokkar Forest (Veil Shienor, Veil Skith, Veil Reskk, Veil Rhaze and the Skettis outskirts) and trade freely. Thirty of them to Vekax, the arakkoa outcast in Lower City, complete The Outcast's Plight for 250 reputation, 3 gold 30 silver and an Outcast's Cache (item 31800). That unlocks the repeatable More Feathers (quest 10918), another 250 reputation per thirty feathers, which the wiki records as available until Honored; the cache holds a random green, blue or occasionally better item. Roughly 1080 feathers take a fresh character to Honored with no dungeons at all.

guides.title: Heroic Tempest Keep: the Warpforged Key
guides.summary: Heroic Mechanar, Botanica and Arcatraz open with the Warpforged Key, sold by Almaador on Shattrath's Terrace of Light once your standing with The Sha'tar is high enough. The Tempest Keep dungeons are the main source, while every Aldor or Scryers quest spills half its reputation into The Sha'tar until Friendly is full. On Anniversary realms a Revered main can buy a Communal pouch whose account bound key covers alts at Friendly.
guides.unlocks: Heroic difficulty for The Mechanar, The Botanica and The Arcatraz, plus their heroic daily quests.

steps.title: Reach level 70
steps.detail: Heroics admit level 70 characters only, and the Tempest Keep dungeons are 67 to 70 content. Pick Aldor or Scryers when you reach Shattrath and quest for them through Nagrand, Shadowmoon Valley and Netherstorm; every one of those quests also pays half its reputation to The Sha'tar until you are at the top of Friendly.

steps.title: Reach Revered with The Sha'tar
steps.detail: Before the Zul'Aman phase the key needs Revered, 21000 points past Neutral. The Mechanar (map 554) and The Botanica (553) pay on normal until Honored (about 1600 and 2200 a full clear); The Arcatraz (552, level 70, needs the Key to the Arcatraz or a rogue) pays on normal to Exalted (about 1800 a clear) and is the main grind, with heroics paying about 2100, 3250 and 2600 once you hold the key. Aldor and Scryers hand ins (Marks of Sargeras or Firewing Signets, Fel Armaments or Arcane Tomes) spill half their reputation into The Sha'tar but only until 5999 into Friendly, so they get you to the doorstep of Honored and no further. Shattrath's own Sha'tar quests (the Arcatraz key chain How to Break Into the Arcatraz, Harbinger of Doom, Special Delivery to Shattrath City, the four Trial of the Naaru quests) add about 5000. Nether-Stalker Mah'duun's normal dailies Wanted: Sunseeker Channelers, Tempest-Forge Destroyers and Arcatraz Sentinels pay 250 each, and Wind Trader Zhareem's heroic dailies 350.

steps.title: Reach Honored with The Sha'tar
steps.detail: From the Zul'Aman phase Almaador sells the key at Honored, 9000 points past Neutral. The Aldor or Scryers spillover carries you to the end of Friendly on its own, so one or two Mechanar (map 554) or Botanica (553) clears, which pay until exactly Honored, finish the job. The Arcatraz (552), the Shattrath Sha'tar quests and Mah'duun's Tempest Keep dailies (250) also count.

The sale is gated on your standing, Revered before phase 4 and Honored from phase 4.

An alt needs only Friendly with The Sha'tar, which the Aldor or Scryers spillover reaches quickly, to hold it and enter Tempest Keep heroics. guides.title: Heroic Caverns of Time: the Key of Time
guides.summary: Heroic Old Hillsbrad Foothills and The Black Morass open with the Key of Time, sold by Alurmi inside the Caverns of Time once your Keepers of Time standing is high enough. Almost all of that reputation comes from the two dungeons and their quest chain, which also gates entry to each of them. On Anniversary realms a Revered main can buy a Communal pouch whose account bound key covers alts at Friendly.
guides.unlocks: Heroic difficulty for Old Hillsbrad Foothills (Escape from Durnholde Keep) and The Black Morass, plus their heroic daily quests.

phase.notes: Key required throughout TBC. Revered from launch; Honored from the Zul'Aman update (original 2.3, TBC Classic Phase 4 on 22 March 2022, Anniversary on 22 October 2026, phase 4 in this numbering).

steps.title: Reach level 70
steps.detail: Heroics admit level 70 characters only. The Caverns of Time chain opens at 66, so most characters do Old Hillsbrad while levelling and the Black Morass at 70; both pay Keepers of Time reputation that counts towards the key.

steps.title: Take the Custodian's tour of the Caverns
steps.detail: At the cavern mouth in eastern Tanaris the Steward of Time (npc 20142, 66.0, 49.7) offers To The Master's Lair (quest 10279), which sends you down to the child Andormu at the bottom of the spiral. Andormu then gives The Caverns of Time (quest 10277): follow the Custodian of Time on a slow circuit of the cavern while it explains each portal, then speak to Andormu again for 250 reputation. Completing this tour is what lets you enter Old Hillsbrad Foothills, so do it before you queue for the dungeon.

steps.title: Finish the Old Hillsbrad chain
steps.detail: Andormu's Old Hillsbrad (quest 10282) sends you to Erozion just inside the Escape from Durnholde Keep instance (map 560). Erozion gives Taretha's Diversion (10283, plant five incendiary charges in the internment lodges) and then Escape from Durnholde (10284, escort Thrall out of the keep, through Tarren Mill and kill the Epoch Hunter). Hand in to Erozion, then take Return to Andormu back to the Caverns for 3000 reputation and a choice of rings. A full normal clear pays about 1045 reputation (1199 if you clear Durnholde and Tarren Mill before starting the event); finishing this chain is also what lets you enter The Black Morass.

steps.title: Defend Medivh in the Black Morass
steps.detail: The adult Andormu (npc 19932, 57.6, 59.0) gives The Black Morass (quest 10296, 250 reputation) which sends you to Sa'at inside the Opening of the Dark Portal instance (map 269). Sa'at's The Opening of the Dark Portal (10297) is the whole dungeon: close eighteen time rifts, keep Medivh alive and kill Chrono Lord Deja, Temporus and Aeonus. Return to the child Andormu for Hero of the Brood, worth 8000 reputation, by far the largest single chunk towards the key, plus a choice of items. A full Black Morass clear pays about 1110 on normal and keeps paying to Exalted.

steps.title: Reach Revered with the Keepers of Time
steps.detail: Before the Zul'Aman phase the key needs Revered, 21000 points past Neutral. The quest chain alone pays over 11500 (250 tour, 3000 Return to Andormu, 250 The Black Morass, 8000 Hero of the Brood), which is Honored already. Old Hillsbrad Foothills (map 560) pays on normal until Honored at about 1045 a clear; The Black Morass (269) pays on normal to Exalted at about 1110 a clear and is the grind to Revered, with heroics paying about 2300 and 1725 once you hold the key. Nether-Stalker Mah'duun's normal daily Wanted: Rift Lords (Black Morass) pays 250 and Wind Trader Zhareem's heroic dailies (Epoch Hunter's Head, Aeonus's Hourglass) pay 350. Revered also lets Zephyr in Shattrath teleport you straight to the Caverns.

steps.title: Reach Honored with the Keepers of Time
steps.detail: From the Zul'Aman phase Alurmi sells the key at Honored, 9000 points past Neutral. Simply completing the chain, the Custodian's tour, the Old Hillsbrad escape with Return to Andormu and one Black Morass with Hero of the Brood, pays over 11500 and takes you past Honored in a single evening. If you stop short of the Black Morass, a couple of Old Hillsbrad clears (about 1045 each, paying until Honored) finish it.

steps.title: Buy the Key of Time
steps.detail: Alurmi, the Keepers of Time quartermaster, stands inside the Caverns of Time near the Old Hillsbrad passage and sells the Key of Time for 10 gold. It binds when picked up, is unique and sits in your keyring; holding it is the attunement for both Caverns of Time heroics. The sale is gated on your standing, Revered before phase 4 and Honored from phase 4. The Caverns have no map of their own on this client, so the coordinates are on the Tanaris map.

An alt needs only Friendly with the Keepers of Time, which the Custodian's tour and the Old Hillsbrad chain give, to hold it and enter Caverns of Time heroics. It is an item, not an account flag, so it must sit in the alt's keyring. Whether the pouch's purchase requirement also dropped to Honored on 22 October 2026 is not confirmed.

guides.title: Heroic Magisters' Terrace: Hard to Kill
guides.summary: Magisters' Terrace on the Isle of Quel'Danas has no key. Heroic access is granted by finishing the Hard to Kill chain, which starts in Shattrath with the Aldor or the Scryers, runs through the Shattered Sun Staging Area and ends with Kael'thas Sunstrider's head from the normal dungeon. It arrives with the Sunwell phase and gives the only heroic in TBC whose attunement is a quest flag rather than an item.
guides.unlocks: Heroic difficulty for Magisters' Terrace, its heroic daily quest, and the chance at Kael'thas' heroic only drops (Phoenix Hatchling, Swift White Hawkstrider).

phase.notes: Original patch 2.4 (25 March 2008); TBC Classic Phase 5 (May 2022); Anniversary Phase 5 is listed as autumn 2026 with no date yet, so nothing in this guide exists on the live Anniversary realms today. The requirement was only lifted in Cataclysm 4.2.

steps.title: Reach level 70
steps.detail: Every quest in the chain requires level 70 and the dungeon is tuned for raid ready characters. Nothing else is needed to start: no reputation, no earlier attunement and no key.

steps.title: Answer the call to the Sunwell
steps.questName: Crisis at the Sunwell (Aldor) or Duty Calls (Scryers)

turnIn.name: Exarch Larethor
turnIn.zone: Isle of Quel'Danas (Shattered Sun Staging Area)

steps.detail: Take whichever version matches your Shattrath faction: Adyen the Lightwarden on the Aldor Rise offers Crisis at the Sunwell (quest 11481), Dathris Sunstriker outside the inn on the Scryer's Tier offers Duty Calls (11482). Both simply send you to Exarch Larethor at the Shattered Sun Staging Area on the Isle of Quel'Danas, reached by the portal in the middle of Shattrath or the flight from Silvermoon or Ironforge, and both pay 10 Shattered Sun Offensive reputation. Either one leads into the same chain.

steps.title: Find Tyrith inside Magisters' Terrace

giver.name: Exarch Larethor
giver.zone: Isle of Quel'Danas (Shattered Sun Staging Area)

steps.detail: Larethor asks you to search Magisters' Terrace for Tyrith, a blood elf spy. Enter the dungeon on normal difficulty (the entrance is on the north east of the Isle, at the far end of the Terrace from the staging area) and fight through to Tyrith, who waits inside past the first boss Selin Fireheart. Hand in to him for 250 reputation; he immediately offers the next step.

steps.title: Use the Scrying Orb and speak with Kalecgos

turnIn.name: Kalecgos
turnIn.zone: Magisters' Terrace (inside the instance, at the Scrying Orb)

steps.detail: Tyrith wants you to activate the Scrying Orb on the open balcony further into the dungeon, past Vexallus. Clear to the orb and use it; an image of Kalecgos appears in his half elven form and shows Kael'thas scheming at the top of the Terrace. Speak to Kalecgos to complete the quest for 250 reputation and take Hard to Kill from him before the image fades.

steps.title: Kill Kael'thas and bring his head to Larethor

turnIn.name: Exarch Larethor
turnIn.zone: Isle of Quel'Danas (Shattered Sun Staging Area)

steps.detail: Kill Kael'thas Sunstrider (npc 24664) at the top of Magisters' Terrace on normal difficulty, after Priestess Delrissa's party, and loot the Head of Kael'thas (item 34157). Kael'thas casts Flame Strike, summons a Phoenix that must be killed and its egg destroyed, and at low health begins Gravity Lapse, lifting everyone into the air; swim away from his Arcane Spheres and keep damage going. Take the head back to Exarch Larethor at the Shattered Sun Staging Area for 250 reputation, 4 gold 40 silver and a choice of a Bright Crimson Spinel (35487) or a Runed Crimson Spinel (35488). Completing this quest is the heroic attunement itself; no key item exists.
steps.detectedBy: IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(11492). GetItemCount(34157) > 0 shows the head in hand before the hand in.

steps.title: Set the dungeon difficulty to Heroic
steps.detail: With Hard to Kill complete, the party leader right clicks their portrait, opens Dungeon Difficulty and chooses Heroic, or runs /run SetDungeonDifficultyID(2). Every member must have completed Hard to Kill themselves; the flag is per character and is not account wide on Anniversary. Heroic Magisters' Terrace locks you to one run per day, awards a Badge of Justice per boss, and is the dungeon behind Wind Trader Zhareem's heroic daily Wanted: The Signet Ring of Prince Kael'thas (Nether-Stalker Mah'duun's normal daily Wanted: Sisters of Torment needs no attunement).

data.notes: Conventions: where a value differs by side the field is an object with A and H keys (quest, item, factionId, giver, turnIn), matching the quest {A,H} convention the task set; the Magisters' Terrace starter uses ALDOR and SCRYERS keys instead. Standing ids follow the client (5 Friendly, 6 Honored, 7 Revered). Each hub guide carries two REP steps with phases: Revered for phases 1 to 3 and Honored from phase 4, because the key purchase requirement dropped with the Zul'Aman update on both timelines (TBC Classic Phase 4, patch 2.5.4, 22 March 2022, Blizzard: Heroic dungeon keys now require Honored reputation, down from Revered; Anniversary 22 October 2026, Blizzard: The reputation requirement to purchase Heroic dungeon keys has been reduced to Honored). The key item itself is required for all of TBC, so phase.requiredUntil is null everywhere. Phase mapping verified: TBC Classic P1 Karazhan/Gruul/Magtheridon, P2 SSC/TK, P3 Hyjal/BT, P4 Zul'Aman, P5 Sunwell; Anniversary launched 5 February 2026, P3 raids opened 27 August 2026, Zul'Aman opened 22 October 2026 (Blizzard calls it the next content phase, Blizzard Watch calls it 3.5; it is phase 4 here, and it also removed Hyjal and Black Temple attunement), Sunwell is TBA autumn 2026. Questie hard codes TBC phase 3, so the addon should not read the phase from Questie. Anniversary specific: all five quartermasters also sell a Communal pouch (80 gold, Revered: Flamewrought 265842 A / 265829 H, Reservoir 265844, Auchenai 265846, Warpforged 265848, Time 265850) containing a Bind to Battle.net account key (Flamewrought 265830 A / 265826 H, Reservoir 265843, Auchenai 265845, Warpforged 265847, Key of Time 265849) usable by any character at Friendly; it is an item that must sit in the alt's keyring, so detection for heroic access is GetItemCount(plain key) > 0 or (GetItemCount(communal key) > 0 and standing >= 5). The plain keys cost 10 gold, bind when picked up and are unique. Daily dungeon givers, both in Shattrath Lower City outside the World's End Tavern: Wind Trader Zhareem (npc 24369, 75.1, 36.6) gives the HEROIC daily (Wanted: a boss item, text says it may only be completed on Heroic difficulty; 2 Badges of Justice, 13 gold 20 silver, 350 Consortium plus 350 with the dungeon's faction, e.g. 11378 Wanted: The Epoch Hunter's Head) and Nether-Stalker Mah'duun (npc 24370, 75.5, 37.2) gives the NORMAL daily (Wanted: kill N trash mobs in a level 70 dungeon; an Ethereum Prison Key, 8 gold 80 silver, 250 Consortium plus 250 with the dungeon's faction, e.g. 11385 Wanted: Sunseeker Channelers). The task text had these two reversed. Also corrected from the task text: Nakodu is npc 21655 (Almaador is 21432; 19321 is Quartermaster Endarin of the Aldor), Mah'duun is 24370 (24932 is Exarch Nasuun), and Marks of Honor Hold / Thrallmar (items 24579 / 24581) are PvP tokens from the Hellfire Fortifications daily (10106 A / 10110 H, 150 reputation) rather than a repeatable reputation hand in.
